subject: Deadwood removal: confirm stage or archive for stalled opportunities
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deadwood removal: confirm stage or archive for stalled opportunities

Team —

Quick hygiene request ahead of the finance forecast refresh: I've exported a set of opportunities that haven't had activity in >90 days (attached: deadwood_export_q1.csv). These have a material impact on our commit signal and forecast accuracy. Please take the following actions by EOD next Wednesday (2/28):

- OWNERS: For each opp you own in the sheet, update one of: "Commit" (if demonstrable next steps and PO/Proc are active), "No-go" (if lost), or "Archive" (no reasonable path in the quarter).
- CLOSE-DATE: If you choose "Commit", set a realistic close-date and add the next concrete milestone in the SF Opportunity comments.
- EVIDENCE: Attach 1) latest customer email or calendar invite and 2) one-line rationale. If evidence exists in the activity log, paste a pointer (see HSL-472 example).

Why this matters: FP&A will lock the model on 3/1 and any stale opps that stay in the commit bucket will inflate our numbers. We should be aggressive about pruning deadwood so the commit pool reflects actual risk.

Links: Google sheet with owners column: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-deadwood-priority
SF view for these opps: https://salesforce.com/opportunity/HSL-472

Attachments: deadwood_export_q1.csv (csv)

Thanks — a concise reply with updates is fine. I will compile and escalate any stuck items.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Yes — please do not invent new labels in the sheet. We need a single truth for commit. Operational guidance:

- "Commit": active commercial momentum (PO in flight, legal signoff imminent, procurement engaged).
- "No-go": confirmed loss or customer stopped evaluation.
- "Archive": no reasonable path this quarter (can be resurrected later, but must be removed from commit).

For legal/ procurement pauses: mark as "At-risk" in Salesforce stage but in the sheet mark as "No-go" only if the customer has explicitly deprioritized. Otherwise mark "Commit" only if PO/Proc email (or signed SOW) exists; otherwise mark "Archive".

Action items: Monica -> I will triage the 12 opps assigned to me today and add 1-line rationale in the sheet. Vivek -> update HSL-472 row with the 2/22 demo and flag the technical milestone. Rishi/Tessa -> please sweep your owned rows and either archive or supply evidence.

I'll consolidate updates on Friday (2/23) and push final handoff to FP&A on Monday.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Account Strategy | Redwood Inference

If procurement intends to pause indefinitely, tell us and we'll set the opportunity to archive for the quarter.

For clarity, our finance team is closing the forecast model on 3/1 and we want to avoid carrying stale opportunities in the commit bucket. A quick reply with one of the following is sufficient: "Procurement engaged — target week of 3/6" or "Paused — archive for Q1".

Thanks for the prompt reply — appreciate it.
